The numbers for "Crazy Cash" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
1134.headline: A close look at the prizes

1140.body:
"$25, $50 or $250" has 596,184 prizes of $25 still unclaimed, which is its most common win. Just below the top prize is the $50 prize, with 119,197 left. The full count for every prize level is listed below.

If you play "$25, $50 or $250" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
1140.headline: What the prize table shows

696.body:
"Monopoly 200X" has two of ten top prizes left and is past the halfway point of its run. About three-quarters of the tickets are already sold. As a game goes on, the same prizes are spread across fewer tickets. Right now, tickets and top prizes are running out at about the same rate.

The table below shows the full count for "Monopoly 200X", with every prize level included.
696.headline: Early stage or late

762.body:
"Billion" can match another game on price and top prize and still pay out very differently. This game is a game built around small prizes that are won often. Of its unclaimed prize money, about three-quarters is in wins under $5,000 and the rest is in bigger prizes. Neither kind is better, and each suits different players.

Two of Billion's four top prizes can still be won.

Everything above about "Billion" comes from the Ohio Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.
762.headline: What type of game it is

827.body:
"50th Anniversary" has had no $15 million top prize claimed for over a month. Everyday prizes keep getting claimed, and fewer tickets are left each day. The number of tickets printed is fixed. Each day without a top prize claim leaves those prizes among fewer tickets.

Today's free summary of "50th Anniversary" ends here. Every number behind it is on this page.
827.headline: Top prizes are still unclaimed

847.body:
Before you buy "Bingo 50X", know that its $500,000 top prize is gone. The game still pays many smaller prizes, but the biggest one left is $100,000. That is still a sizable prize, but much smaller than the one shown on the ticket.

The numbers for "Bingo 50X" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
847.headline: No top prizes remain

891.body:
Most of the tickets for "Cash Explosion 25X" have been sold. The game is in the last part of its run. The key question is whether the tickets or the top prizes run out first. Right now, tickets are selling faster than top prizes are being claimed, which is good for the tickets that are left.

Every line of Cash Explosion 25X's prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
891.headline: How far along this game is
